title: Savannah
excerpt: Meet Savannah – A Fully Custom Off-Grid Mercedes Sprinter 170 AWD Camper Van Designed for adventure without limits, Savannah is a top-tier Mercedes Sprinter 170 AWD conversion built with the El Capitan package, offering
body: Designed for adventure without limits, Savannah is a top-tier Mercedes Sprinter 170 AWD conversion built with the El Capitan package, offering the perfect balance of off-grid capability and modern luxury. From its high-capacity lithium power system to its elevated interior finishes, this van is built for those who demand both rugged durability and premium comfort on the road.

Equipped with an 800Ah lithium iron battery system, 400W solar panels, and a 50Amp DC-DC charger, Savannah is ready for extended boondocking. A 3000W pure sine wave inverter/charger keeps high-powered appliances running smoothly, while multiple 110V outlets with USB and USB-C ports provide seamless device charging. The 30Amp shore power connection adds flexibility for plugging in when needed.

The kitchen is designed for convenience and efficiency with an in-counter double burner induction cooktop, a stainless steel undermount sink, and an Isotherm Cruise 130 refrigerator with freezer. A 700W microwave ensures quick meal prep, while the acacia butcher block countertop and custom backsplash tile bring a refined touch to the space.

The interior is lined with painted shiplap walls, a wood-stained ceiling, and recessed dimmable LED lighting, creating a warm, inviting atmosphere. Vinyl wood-style flooring ensures durability and easy maintenance.

With a 12V Nomadic rooftop A/C unit, an Espar diesel heater, and a Maxxair Deluxe ceiling fan, Savannah is ready for extreme temperatures. The premium insulation package with Havelock wool helps maintain interior comfort in any season.

The Lippert Smart Bed lift system allows for a flexible sleeping arrangement, raising and lowering at the push of a button. The dinette converts into an additional bed, offering space for guests. Swivel captain’s chairs for the driver and passenger add versatility, while the CVC double captain’s chair in the rear provides extra seating.

This van includes a fully tiled indoor shower with hot and cold water, a Laveo Dry Flush Toilet, and a 20-gallon over-the-wheel water tank for long-term travel. A rear door outdoor shower makes it easy to rinse off after off-road excursions.

Designed to handle rugged terrain, Savannah rides on Black Rhino Armory Gun Black all-terrain wheels and features a roof rack with a side ladder for added gear storage. A passenger-side T-Vent window and three RB Components bunk windows provide ample ventilation and natural light. The electric awning with integrated LED lighting extends the living space outdoors.
Built for full-time van life, weekend getaways, and off-road exploration, Savannah is the ultimate luxury adventure van with the power, comfort, and durability to take you anywhere.
